name: Kuo-toa
sourceDistinctions: The core monster entry confirms the Aquatic subtype. The Monstrous Humanoid type supplies 60-ft. darkvision.
The Underdark player Light Blindness penalty covers all attacks, saves, and checks in bright light. The core monster uses dazzled after abrupt exposure.
Adhesive uses Constitution, and the cooperative Lightning Bolt uses the highest participating whip Wisdom. The two original builds use neither the monster bite nor the core creature feat package.
The racial and regional language lists differ. Both original builds use the racial list, with Common selected as a bonus language.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Underdark errata file or Kuo-toa racial rules correction.
portraitForm: Lilli Seachild, an original Kuo-toa Fighter with a coated shield
